column1: # The licence text of every component linked into the pagefeather engine (#582), keyed to the
# link inputs wasm-ld --trace reports (build/link-inputs.txt). engine/tools/licenses.py fails when a
# traced input matches no row, or a fetched text does not have the pinned sha256.
# Columns (tab-separated): out-file  component  version  spdx  match  kind  source  member  lines  sha256
#   match: a regex on the input path, or ALWAYS (the JS loader and the build itself carry it)
#   kind: local (a repo file) | raw (a URL) | tar (a member of the tarball at the URL)
#   lines: a-b to keep only those lines, or -
#   sha256: of the text written, or MEASURE (licenses.py --measure prints it)

column2: the third-party code bundled in PHP
